vocab.coverage: Six Study Scoop practice questions, one per quiz word. The school quiz length is not stated.
vocab.instructions: Choose the word that matches each class-sheet definition. Select Finish the test when you are done.
vocab.note: Study Scoop practice for the December 4 vocabulary quiz.

items.prompt: Which word matches this class-sheet definition? "to tear down and destroy"

options.why: Projects: tasks that take time and effort to complete
Precious: something that is important or valuable
Assigned: Gave someone a task to do.

items.explain: Demolition: to tear down and destroy. In everyday words: The act of tearing down or destroying something.
